name: Childbearing
overview: Scripture reveals that childbearing is a divinely ordained blessing and responsibility, as God commands humanity to be fruitful and multiply, filling the earth and exercising dominion over it (Genesis 1:28). The creation of woman as a suitable helper for man underscores the complementary design within marriage (Genesis 2:18), while the reality of childbirth includes both joy and sorrow due to the fall (Genesis 3:16). God’s sovereign power is evident in opening the womb and blessing the barren, enabling joyful motherhood as a testimony of His grace and faithfulness (Genesis 30:22; Deuteronomy 7:14; Psalms 113:9).
